title: Health over the Life Course
description: Notions of health, wellness and who is deserving of health care are socially-constructed concepts. An examination of some of the main sociological ways of conceptualizing and studying health across the life course, leading into the social factors and social institutions that shape individual health trajectories. Concludes with a discussion of interventions to promote equitable health across the life course.
recommendations: Recommended prior to SOCI 327, SOCI 385, and SOCI 432.
